frameConvention: Zero-based decoded native source frame numbers, inclusive. Preview footage is a trimmed native source selection.

entries.title: Restaurant photo strip
entries.description: Browse five photos side to side while the restaurant name, action row, tabs and address stay fixed.

anatomy.moving: One horizontal rail containing five independent images. The image positions share the same x displacement.
anatomy.fixed: Venue name, detail line, action row, tabs, divider, address, and the photo viewport. All four tested text/control patches had zero integer x/y shift.
anatomy.mask: The restaurant document owns the bounded photo viewport. The viewport clips the rail. Individual images also own their corner masks.
anatomy.anchor: Viewport top left at source (195,303). The fixed venue name sits above it, outside the viewport.

safe: Replace image files in the same five slots. Images use centered cover and stay independently editable.
Change adjacent copy/palette in an authored context. Check for overflow.
Move or uniformly scale the complete block via its parent.
changesInteraction: Changing count, slot width, gap, viewport, travel direction, duration or sample spacing changes the observed interaction.
A reading hold on the last event frame is an editorial freeze during the swipe.

cues.source: Source has an audio track. No isolated source swipe or finger/contact cue is established.

limits: The 21-frame preset is a mid-swipe extract. No release/contact, actual settled hold or exit occurs within it.
Offscreen objects and finger trajectory remain unknown. Sample arrivals and pauses are visible picture behavior.
Relative rail x is measured. Rounded corners, invisible image extents and isolated/context styling are authored approximations.

measurement.method: Integer edge measurements across y=355–589. Threshold median background difference, match photo edges/gutters across frames and register title, tabs, action and address patches independently. Compare positional repeats and adjacent controls before fitting. Native source frames were decoded without resampling.
measurement.uncertainty: Rail dx about ±2 px from thresholding/chroma/compression; 499 px bowl extent is a visible edge fit. The y boundary varies about 1 px, and fixed elements have zero integer x/y shift (subpixel/codec differences remain). Hidden façade extent is inferred from the retained crop. No hand or off-viewport trajectory is visible.
measurement.slotAssetProvenance: Existing individual source-derived component crops in Linq scene assets. No source page/movie is used as a moving layer.

contrasts.note: A web-style card rail panning under fixed chrome vs the native multi-photo bundle — both get called "carousel".
